artworks.title: The Flaying of Marsyas
artworks.description: Titian's late masterpiece — Apollo flaying the satyr who dared rival the lyre, the tears that Ovid says became the Phrygian river Marsyas.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.description: Raphael's Vatican stanza — the music contest before the punishment, Athena's abandoned pipes in the satyr's hands.
